scientific_scope_status: For the same fixed irrational phase alpha=(sqrt(5)-1)/2 throughout, p_k=(1+cos(2 pi alpha k))/2, arbitrary homogeneous n-state stochastic P, initial distribution mu and terminal readout f in [0,1]^n, with identical wait commands and one terminal read, N_alpha(T,epsilon)=Theta_(alpha,epsilon)(T^(1/3)) for each fixed 0<epsilon<1/4. The terminal readout receives only the evolved state and is not additionally handed k or an external lookup table. At zero error separately T<=N_alpha(T,0)<=T+1; an ideal qubit realizes the probabilities. This is not a runtime, physical clock, joint-output-process, or practical computing advantage. An ordinary counter/cosine uses O(log T) bits and phase/gate precision is O(log(T/epsilon)).
